en: Sepia-toned photograph of a stone statue of a bearded man in rustic clothes and hat, holding a lantern and standing on a high pedestal beside an arched medieval-style doorway. The doorway has rich Romanesque-style carvings around it and a dark wooden door with small decorative studs. A cobblestone street lies in the foreground, and a shop window with various goods is visible on the right edge. The building façade appears old and worn, with a barred window to the left and a smaller modern window above.
